hypothesis: Replace the general three-word value interning probe for sorts at raw universe-level ids below 4096 with a direct indexed per-Vals table. Larger ids retain the original interner.
scope: Standalone change: no recursor-demand, Pi, worker or other prototype is combined. Exact LevelId keys and all value/session reset boundaries are retained. Table storage enters the existing byte budgets.
cost_gate: Two alternating exact 25131-declaration prefix pairs, two workers; at least 1% fewer software instructions in each pair and aggregate; four complete ACCEPTs and three exact loop controls.
correctness_gate: Sort identity, distinct levels, boundary ids and reset controls; full library suite and 16 source-record controls before measuring. A passed prefix cost gate requires all portable cases and full-input qualification before promotion.
provenance: Gruszka direct sort/constant tables motivated replacing a general lookup. Independently authored on the existing credited Flash source; no competitor implementation copied.
